import { Button, FlexLayout, H2, StackLayout, Text } from "@salt-ds/core";

  return (
    <StackLayout gap={2}>

      <FlexLayout gap={1}>
        <Button size="large" appearance="solid" sentiment="accented">
          Release {payments.length} payments
        </Button>
      </FlexLayout>
    </StackLayout>
  );
}
